About me

I am a newly graduated BEng in Process and Innovation from DTU, specialising in UX research and human-centred product development. During my time at Demant, I worked across the research process — from participant recruitment and study design to interviews, analysis, prototyping and stakeholder communication.

I enjoy making complex products easier to understand and use. My engineering background helps me navigate technical products and systems and work closely with developers and other specialists, while my UX experience keeps user needs central throughout the process.

With experience from Demant and LiqTech, I bring a broad perspective on product development, research and collaboration. I am now based in Aarhus and curious about opportunities where technology, users and meaningful solutions meet.

Reasons to
hire me

(that you won't find on my CV)

I know how to enjoy life

Concerts, travel and new experiences are at the top of my list, and I rarely say no to a ticket. So if you need ideas for the team day, or just want to know what's on in town this weekend, you know who to ask.

I play well with others

I've always played team sports, and these days it's floorball. The sports have changed, but the lesson hasn't: You never win alone, and you have to be able to take a pass, even when it's a little off target.

I go all in on an idea

For Halloween, I was a bunch of purple grapes. It took a lot of balloons. Once I'm on board with an idea, I don't do it halfway. You can look forward to my costume at the next company party.

I say yes to new things

At folk high school, I tried beekeeping. Just because. I'm always curious to try new things and approach them with an open mind, even when they buzz. The same goes for new ideas, methods and tools at work.

I find the coffee machine first

Some call it a caffeine addiction. I call it stakeholder mapping: Where the coffee is, the colleagues are, and that's where the good conversations happen.

Everything work-related is on my CV.
